from collections import Counter
def bestshift(a,b):
    # returns list of (mismatch_count, shift) for b[c]=a[(c-s)%n]
    n=len(a); res=[]
    for s in range(n):
        mm=sum(1 for c in range(n) if b[c]!=a[(c-s)%n])
        res.append((mm,s))
    return sorted(res)[:3]

import numpy as np

def parse_msg_grid(text, label):
    i = text.find(label)
    seg = text[i:i+4000]
    rows = []
    for ln in seg.split('\n')[1:]:
        ln = ln.strip()
        if not ln or not ln[0].isdigit(): break
        rows.append([int(x) for x in ln.split()])
    return np.array(rows)

def blocks(g):
    vals = [v for v in np.unique(g) if v != 0]
    shape = max(vals, key=lambda v: (g==v).sum()) if vals else None
    # shape color = the minority pattern color? use: color of the pattern blocks
    # determine per demo: bg = most common, shape = other
    cnt = Counter(g.flatten().tolist())
    bg = max(cnt, key=cnt.get)
    sc = [v for v in cnt if v != bg][0]
    rows = [r for r in range(g.shape[0]) if (g[r]==sc).any()]
    # split into contiguous groups
    groups = []
    cur = [rows[0]]
    for r in rows[1:]:
        if r == cur[-1]+1: cur.append(r)
        else: groups.append(cur); cur=[r]
    groups.append(cur)
    return sc, groups

def solve(demo_in, demo_out):
    sc, gr = blocks(demo_in)
    A, B = gr  # top block rows, bottom block rows
    T = demo_in[A[0]:A[-1]+1]
    Bm = demo_in[B[0]:B[-1]+1]
    To = demo_out[A[0]:A[-1]+1]
    Bo = demo_out[B[0]:B[-1]+1]
    results = []
    for src_is_top in [True, False]:
        S = T if src_is_top else Bm
        C = Bm if src_is_top else T
        So = To if src_is_top else Bo
        Sw = S.shape[1]  # source block width (cols 0..Sw-1)
        for d in (-1, 0):
            anomalies = 0
            marks = []  # (local row, col) in source frame
            ext = []    # extension marks (beyond source width, same column)
            H, Wc = C.shape
            for i in range(H):
                crow = C[i]; srow = S[i] if i < S.shape[0] else None
                for c in range(Wc):
                    cs = crow[c] == sc
                    if c >= Sw:
                        if cs: ext.append((i,c))
                        continue
                    p = srow[c-d] if 0 <= c-d < Sw else None  # pred: copy[c]=source[c-d]
                    if cs and (p is not None and p != sc):  # extra (pred bg inside block)
                        anomalies += 1
                        if srow[c] != sc: marks.append((i,c))
                    elif (not cs) and p == sc:  # missing
                        anomalies += 1
                        if srow[c] != sc: marks.append((i,c))
            results.append((anomalies, src_is_top, d, marks, ext, So))
    return results

def apply(inp, src_is_top, d, marks, ext, sc):
    out = inp.copy()
    _, gr = blocks(inp)
    A, B = gr
    Srows = A if src_is_top else B
    Crows = B if src_is_top else A
    S = inp[Srows[0]:Srows[-1]+1]; C = inp[Crows[0]:Crows[-1]+1]
    Sw = S.shape[1]
    for (i,c) in marks: out[Srows[0]+i, c] = 1
    for (i,c) in ext:   out[Srows[0]+i, c] = 1
    return out

def solve2(gi, go=None):
    sc, gr = blocks(gi)
    A, B = gr
    H, W = gi.shape
    cands = []
    for src_rows, cpy_rows in [(A,B),(B,A)]:
        S = gi[src_rows[0]:src_rows[-1]+1]; C = gi[cpy_rows[0]:cpy_rows[-1]+1]
        # source block width = max shape col +1
        Sw = max(np.where((S==sc).any(axis=0))[0])+1
        for d in (-1,0):
            matched = missing = 0
            paint = []  # (row_in_src, col) absolute-col in source frame
            for i in range(C.shape[0]):
                srow = S[i] if i < S.shape[0] else None
                for c in range(C.shape[1]):
                    cs = C[i,c]==sc
                    if c >= Sw:
                        if cs: paint.append((i,c))   # extension, same column
                        continue
                    pc = c-d
                    if 0 <= pc < W:
                        ps = (srow[pc]==sc) if srow is not None else False
                    else:
                        ps = None  # off-grid
                    if cs and ps:
                        matched += 1
                    elif cs and ps is False:
                        # extra: paint source cell at same col if bg
                        if srow[c] != sc: paint.append((i,c))
                    elif (not cs) and ps:
                        missing += 1
                        paint.append((i,pc))  # source cell whose image is missing
            cands.append((matched, -missing, src_rows is A, d, paint))
    cands.sort(reverse=True)
    m, nm, sit, d, paint = cands[0]
    out = gi.copy()
    base = (A[0] if sit else B[0])
    for (i,c) in paint: out[base+i, c] = 1
    return out, cands

for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    gi, go = D[n]
    out, cands = solve2(gi)
    top3 = [(c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]) for c in cands[:4]]
    print(f"demo{n}: exact={np.array_equal(out,go)} cands(match,-miss,srcTop,d): {top3}")

def stats(src_rows, cpy_rows, d):
    S = ti[src_rows[0]:src_rows[-1]+1]; C = ti[cpy_rows[0]:cpy_rows[-1]+1]
    H,W = ti.shape
    ex=miss=match=0
    for i in range(C.shape[0]):
        srow=S[i] if i<S.shape[0] else None
        for c in range(W):
            cs=C[i,c]==sc; pc=c-d
            ps=(0<=pc<W and srow[pc]==sc) if (srow is not None and 0<=pc<W) else None
            if cs and ps: match+=1
            elif cs: ex+=1
            elif ps: miss+=1
    return match,ex,miss

def blocks(g):
    vals = [v for v in np.unique(g) if v != 0]
    shape = max(vals, key=lambda v: (g==v).sum()) if vals else None
    # shape color = the minority pattern color? use: color of the pattern blocks
    # determine per demo: bg = most common, shape = other
    cnt = Counter(g.flatten().tolist())
    bg = max(cnt, key=cnt.get)
    sc = [v for v in cnt if v != bg][0]
    rows = [r for r in range(g.shape[0]) if (g[r]==sc).any()]
    # split into contiguous groups
    groups = []
    cur = [rows[0]]
    for r in rows[1:]:
        if r == cur[-1]+1: cur.append(r)
        else: groups.append(cur); cur=[r]
    groups.append(cur)
    return sc, groups

def solve3(gi):
    sc, grps = blocks(gi)
    H, W = gi.shape
    T, B = grps[0], grps[1]
    extT = [max((c for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==sc), default=-1) for r in T]
    extB = [max((c for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==sc), default=-1) for r in B]
    srcT = max(extT) <= max(extB)   # truncated block is source
    src, cpy, se, ce = (T,B,extT,extB) if srcT else (B,T,extB,extT)
    base = src[0]
    out = [list(row) for row in gi]
    best = None
    for d in (-1,0,1):
        out_ = [list(row) for row in gi]
        marks = []
        for i in range(len(src)):
            end = min(ce[i]-d, W-1)
            for c in range(se[i]+1, end+1):
                if out_[base+i][c] != sc:
                    out_[base+i][c] = 1
                    marks.append((base+i,c))
        if best is None or len(marks) > len(best[1]):
            best = (d, marks, out_)
    d, marks, out_ = best
    return out_, (srcT, d, len(marks))

ok = True
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    gi_, go_ = D[n]
    o_, info = solve3(gi_)
    match = (np.array(o_)==np.array(go_)).all()
    print(f"demo{n}: exact={match} info={info}")
    ok &= match
print("ALL EXACT:", ok)

def solve5(gi):
    gi = np.array(gi); H,W = gi.shape
    sc, grps = blocks(gi)
    top_g, bot_g = grps
    out = gi.copy()
    marks=[]
    for i,br in enumerate(bot_g):
        tr = top_g[i]
        brow, trow = gi[br], gi[tr]
        # choose d maximizing match: bot c <-> top c-d
        best=None
        for d in range(-W,W+1):
            m=tot=0
            for c in range(W):
                tc=c-d
                if 0<=tc<W:
                    tot+=1
                    if (brow[c]==sc)==(trow[tc]==sc): m+=1
            sc_=(m,tot,d)
            if best is None or (m-tot*1e-6)>(best[0]-best[1]*1e-6): best=(m,tot,d)
        m,tot,d=best
        for c in range(W):
            tc=c-d
            if 0<=tc<W and brow[c]==sc and trow[tc]!=sc:
                out[tr,tc]=1; marks.append((tr,tc))
    return out, marks, [(m,t,d) for m,t,d in [ (0,0,0)]]

# validate on demos
ok=True
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    gi,go = D[n]
    o,marks,_ = solve5(gi)
    exact = np.array_equal(o, np.array(go))
    print(f"demo {n}: exact={exact} marks={sorted(marks)}")
    ok &= exact
print("ALL EXACT:", ok)

def solve7(gi, src_mode='smaller'):
    gi=np.array(gi); H,W=gi.shape
    sc,grps=blocks(gi)
    def ext(row): return max([c for c in range(W) if row[c]==sc] or [-1])
    te=max(ext(gi[r]) for r in grps[0]); be=max(ext(gi[r]) for r in grps[1])
    if te<=be: src_rows,cp_rows=grps[0],grps[1]
    else: src_rows,cp_rows=grps[1],grps[0]
    out=gi.copy(); marks=[]
    for i,sr in enumerate(src_rows):
        cr=cp_rows[i]; srow,crow=gi[sr],gi[cr]
        se=ext(srow)
        best=None
        for d in range(-W,W+1):
            m=tot=0
            for s in range(se+1):   # restrict to source extent
                cc=s+d
                if 0<=cc<W:
                    tot+=1
                    if (srow[s]==sc)==(crow[cc]==sc): m+=1
            if tot==0: continue
            key=(m,-abs(d))
            if best is None or key>best[0]: best=(key,d)
        d=best[1]
        for s in range(W):
            cc=s+d
            if 0<=cc<W and srow[s]!=sc and crow[cc]==sc:
                out[sr,s]=1; marks.append((sr,s))
    return out,marks

def blocks(g):
    g = np.array(g); H, W = g.shape
    vals, cnts = np.unique(g, return_counts=True)
    sc = vals[int(np.argmax(cnts))]  # background/majority
    rows = [r for r in range(H) if np.any(g[r] != sc)]
    # group contiguous block rows
    grps = []
    for r in rows:
        if grps and r == grps[-1][-1] + 1:
            grps[-1].append(r)
        else:
            grps.append([r])
    # shape color = minority color within blocks
    sub = g[[r for grp in grps for r in grp]]
    nv, nc = np.unique(sub, return_counts=True)
    shape = [v for v, c in zip(nv, nc) if v != sc]
    return sc, grps

def transform(grid):
    gi = np.array(grid); H, W = gi.shape
    sc, grps = blocks(gi)
    top_g, bot_g = grps[0], grps[1]

    def ext(row):
        c = [c for c in range(W) if row[c] == sc]
        return max(c) if c else -1

    out = gi.copy()
    for i, sr in enumerate(src_rows):

        srow, crow = gi[sr], gi[cr]
        se = ext(srow)
        # best shift d: copy col c <-> source col c-d, compared over source extent

        for d in range(-W, W + 1):
